description: Reads a phasor as a bar of a set number of steps and gives three phasors, each spanning its own number of those steps, for polymetric parts from one clock

params.text: Sets how many steps one cycle of the input phasor counts as, 1 to 64, 4 when new
Attenuverts the input steps CV, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V adds 64 steps
Sets how many input steps one cycle of that output phasor spans, 1 to 64, 4 when new; matching the input step count runs it in step, anything else drifts against it
Attenuverts that channel's output steps CV, -1 to +1; at full depth 5V adds 64 steps

inputs.text: Adds to the input step count, scaled by the input steps attenuverter
Adds to that channel's output step count, scaled by that channel's attenuverter
The phasor read as the bar, 0-10V
A rising edge restarts that channel's phasor at 0V

outputs.text: A 0-10V phasor spanning that channel's number of input steps
A 10V pulse each time that channel's phasor wraps back to the start

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
